name: Casey Askar

items.why: The item is a Democratic committee's broad 'shady business practices' attack, which is opponent criticism with no specific proven wrongdoing under the self-dealing and abuse-of-office criterion.

for_review: The Floridian article would not open, so I only saw its text in a search snippet. The DCCC race page is the source of the mailer's claims, and it calls the allegations 'alleged' or 'accused'. The owner-sites search returned nothing about Askar. The CNN story (Sept 30, 2026) would not open. According to its search snippet, a court ruled Askar's business owed a former partner more than $900,000 in a contract dispute, and the Seminole Tribe sued his fuel business in 2016 over trade secrets, which he denied. Both are private business disputes, not shown to be abuse of office. A person should check those, plus the 2019-era FEC complaint about a loan to his campaign, which his campaign called bogus (I did not find an outcome). Also check the claim that he received an excessive-contribution investigation. The caseyaskarfiles.com site is anonymous and partisan-looking, so I did not rely on it. Askar appears to have lost the Nov 2026 general election to Pia Dandiya per CBS12.
